nodes.name: latest_snapshot_pass.json
nodes.summary: Snapshot test fixture representing a passing engine run (verdict PASS, not forced) with full guards, revision policy, tier1/tier2 series, quality summary, and grouped values. Used as the golden expected snapshot for the snapshot test suite.
nodes.languageNotes: Large structured JSON snapshot of engine state (~711 lines) capturing guards, revision risk, series tiers, and value groups for deterministic snapshot comparison.

nodes.name: snapshot_fail.json
nodes.summary: Snapshot test fixture representing a failing engine run (verdict FAIL, not forced), exercising the snapshot suite's negative/failure path with the same schema as the passing fixture.
nodes.languageNotes: Mirrors the pass fixture's schema but with verdict FAIL to drive the failure branch of snapshot validation.

nodes.name: snapshot_forced.json
nodes.summary: Snapshot test fixture representing a forced engine run (verdict PASS with forced=true), exercising the override/forced-execution path of the snapshot suite using the same schema as the other fixtures.
nodes.languageNotes: Sets forced=true in both the top-level flag and the guards block to validate forced-snapshot behavior.
